# Per-Cell Area Plots — one cell type per chunk

Singlets are skipped throughout — per-cell area is identical to total area
when count = 1. See Area/Graphs for singlet plots.

```{r pc-plot-setup}
source("Area/R/plot_pc_area_all_comparisons.R")

# Override y-axis label (already done in the sourced file, but be explicit)
y_lab_area <- expression(paste("Per-cell area (", mu, "m"^2, "/cell)"))

# --- Shared helpers ---
area_to_count <- c(ins_area = "Count.ins", glu_area = "Count.glu",
                   soma_area = "Count.soma", pp_area = "Count.PP")

split_per_cell_plot <- function(data, cell_col) {
  count_col <- area_to_count[[cell_col]]
  pc_col <- paste0(cell_col, "_pc")
  log_col <- paste0("log_", cell_col, "_pc")
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(cell_col)) & !!sym(cell_col) > 0 &
           !!sym(count_col) > 0) %>%
    mutate(!!pc_col := !!sym(cell_col) / !!sym(count_col),
           !!log_col := log(!!sym(cell_col) / !!sym(count_col)))
}

add_object_type <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(object_type = factor(case_when(
    Islet.Cells == 1 ~ "Singlets",
    Islet.Cells >= 2 & Islet.Cells <= 14 ~ "SEOs",
    Islet.Cells >= 15 ~ "Islets"),
    levels = c("Singlets", "SEOs", "Islets")))
}

set_factors <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(Diagnosis = factor(Diagnosis, levels = c("ND", "T1D")),
                Region = factor(Region, levels = c("Head", "Body", "Tail")),
                Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
                Donor = factor(Donor), ImageID = factor(ImageID))
}
set_factors_t1d <- function(df) set_factors(df) %>% droplevels()

# Load subset-specific data (no singlets needed for per-cell)
p_endobs       <- set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_endobs.rds"))
p_islets       <- set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_islets.rds"))
p_endobs_t1d   <- set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_endobs_t1d.rds"))
p_islets_t1d   <- set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_islets_t1d.rds"))

p_beta_comb      <- add_object_type(set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_beta_combined.rds")))
p_alpha_comb     <- add_object_type(set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_alpha_combined.rds")))
p_delta_comb     <- add_object_type(set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_delta_combined.rds")))
p_pp_comb        <- add_object_type(set_factors(readRDS("Data/area_data_pp_combined.rds")))
p_beta_comb_t1d  <- add_object_type(set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_beta_combined_t1d.rds")))
p_alpha_comb_t1d <- add_object_type(set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_alpha_combined_t1d.rds")))
p_delta_comb_t1d <- add_object_type(set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_delta_combined_t1d.rds")))
p_pp_comb_t1d    <- add_object_type(set_factors_t1d(readRDS("Data/area_data_pp_combined_t1d.rds")))

model_dir  <- "Area/Models/Per_Cell_Area"
output_dir <- "Area/Graphs/Per_Cell_Area"

pc_area_cols <- list(
  beta = "ins_area_pc", alpha = "glu_area_pc",
  delta = "soma_area_pc", pp = "pp_area_pc"
)

# Helper to run one cell type end-to-end (no singlets)
run_pc_cell_type <- function(ct, cell_col, label, comb_diag, comb_t1d) {
  pc_col <- pc_area_cols[[ct]]
  cat("\n===", toupper(label), "===\n")
  cat("  Singlets SKIPPED (per-cell \u2261 total area; see Area/Graphs)\n")

  # --- DIAGNOSIS: SEOs ---
  cat("  Diag SEOs...\n")
  d <- split_per_cell_plot(p_endobs, cell_col)
  m <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, paste0("pc_", ct, "_2to14.rds")))
  generate_area_diag_plots(m, d, paste(label, "(SEOs)"), pc_col, TRUE,
                            file.path(output_dir, ct, "Diagnosis", "2to14"))
  rm(m); gc(); closeAllConnections()

  # --- DIAGNOSIS: Islets ---
  cat("  Diag Islets...\n")
  d <- split_per_cell_plot(p_islets, cell_col)
  m <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, paste0("pc_", ct, "_15plus.rds")))
  generate_area_diag_plots(m, d, paste(label, "(Islets)"), pc_col, TRUE,
                            file.path(output_dir, ct, "Diagnosis", "15plus"))
  rm(m); gc(); closeAllConnections()

  # --- DIAGNOSIS: Combined ---
  cat("  Diag combined...\n")
  m <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, paste0("pc_", ct, "_combined.rds")))
  d <- split_per_cell_plot(comb_diag, cell_col)
  generate_area_combined_diag_plots(m, d, paste(label, "(combined)"), pc_col,
                                     file.path(output_dir, ct, "Diagnosis", "combined"))
  rm(m); gc(); closeAllConnections()

  # --- T1D: SEOs ---
  cat("  T1D SEOs...\n")
  d <- split_per_cell_plot(p_endobs_t1d, cell_col)
  m <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, paste0("pc_", ct, "_2to14_t1d.rds")))
  generate_area_t1d_plots(m, d, paste(label, "(SEOs)"), pc_col, TRUE,
                           file.path(output_dir, ct, "T1D", "2to14"))
  rm(m); gc(); closeAllConnections()

  # --- T1D: Islets ---
  cat("  T1D Islets...\n")
  d <- split_per_cell_plot(p_islets_t1d, cell_col)
  m <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, paste0("pc_", ct, "_15plus_t1d.rds")))
  generate_area_t1d_plots(m, d, paste(label, "(Islets)"), pc_col, TRUE,
                           file.path(output_dir, ct, "T1D", "15plus"))
  rm(m); gc(); closeAllConnections()

  # --- T1D: Combined ---
  cat("  T1D combined...\n")
  m <- readRDS(file.path(model_dir, paste0("pc_", ct, "_combined_t1d.rds")))
  d <- split_per_cell_plot(comb_t1d, cell_col)
  generate_area_combined_t1d_plots(m, d, paste(label, "(combined)"), pc_col,
                                    file.path(output_dir, ct, "T1D", "combined"))
  rm(m); gc(); closeAllConnections()

  cat("  ", label, "COMPLETE\n")
}
```

```{r pc-plot-beta}
run_pc_cell_type("beta", "ins_area", "\u03b2 per-cell area",
                  p_beta_comb, p_beta_comb_t1d)
gc(); closeAllConnections()
```

```{r pc-plot-alpha}

                  p_alpha_comb, p_alpha_comb_t1d)
gc(); closeAllConnections()
```

```{r pc-plot-delta}
gc(); closeAllConnections()
```
